content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DCPU Andaman Accountant Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://northmiddle.andaman.nic.in/. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 17-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DCPU Andaman Accountant position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Accountant post at District Child Protection Unit Andaman is 17th October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Accountant role?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Graduate degree in Commerce or Mathematics from a recognized university, along with at least one year of relevant experience and proficiency in Tally.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Accountant post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Accountant position is 40 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Accountant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 18,536/-.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Accountant job at DCPU Andaman?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline by sending the completed form to the official address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Accountant role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves application verification, followed by an interview and document verification.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The Accountant position is a contractual job.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of DCPU Andaman, provided in the Important Links section.

faq.question: Q10. What is the total number of vacancies for the Accountant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Accountant post in the District Child Protection Unit Andaman.
